translations./title: Recognize that a museum tool cannot answer a question about dancers
translations./summary: The user asks about famous dancers of the 19th century. The only available tool, `get_museum_artists`, finds artists whose works are held by a museum during a specified period. It requires `museum_name` and `period`.
translations./presentation/methods/1/description: Explains that the tool cannot search for dancers and does not call it.
translations./presentation/methods/3/description: Chooses the Metropolitan Museum of Art without asking, then acknowledges the mismatch after the query.
translations./presentation/methods/0/description: Explains that the tool cannot search for dancers and does not call it.
translations./presentation/methods/6/description: Chooses the Louvre and France without asking, then acknowledges the mismatch after the query.
translations./presentation/methods/4/description: Chooses the Louvre without asking, then acknowledges the mismatch after the query.
translations./presentation/methods/5/description: Calls the museum tool without the required `museum_name`.
translations./presentation/methods/2/description: Chooses the Metropolitan Museum of Art and substitutes a museum query for the requested dancer search.
translations./presentation/turns/0/label: Actions and replies after inspecting the tool
